scope: Fixed source-location/field/text matching of the top three results; not Agent answer faithfulness or native execution
privacy: Only query IDs, document IDs, source IDs, versions and evidence levels; no source text, index or local paths

public.role: Official: repository sources + full keyword_docs catalog; no public Scripting API exists, so api cases count as misses

private_supplementary.role: Supplementary only: adds local private API/user-guide text extracts whose source path is not user-confirmed (I05 gap stays open); version recorded as unspecified

holdout_b.role: Independent set written before tuning by a separate agent that never saw the glossary or code changes; not read by the tuner before code freeze
